_comment: PAPER-ONLY 6-stage desk: Scout > Filter (binary gates, fail-closed) > Analyst (0-100, 70+) > Executor > Risk > Logger. No wallet, no signing, no live orders, and no live-trading switch exists in this code.

risk._exits: The hard stop is set before entry and never lowered. A trail only ratchets it up. The manage loop also exits on liq_drop when pool liquidity falls more than liq_drop_from_entry_pct from entry, or below gates.min_liquidity_usd. Nothing else closes a position.

entry._comment: Extra entry protection on top of the existing gates. Fail closed if the 5m path is missing. max_fill_worse_than_mark_pct compares the paper fill with the DexScreener mark. The pre-buy sell quote reuses gates.max_round_trip_loss_pct. Does not change the hard stop, trail, size, or scout window.

brake._comment: Pause NEW entries for the rest of the America/Edmonton day. Open positions are still managed. Day P&L is realized plus unrealized versus equity at local midnight. A single close at or below max_single_loss_pct also trips it, and it stays on even if P&L recovers.

sources._comment: gmgn_enabled: use GMGN when a personal key is in ~/.config/gmgn/.env (or secrets/gmgn.env). use_free_sources_when_no_gmgn: if no key (or a GMGN call fails), bundle = RugCheck insider/cluster share (>10% kill), creator history = pump.fun created-coins when reachable, else RugCheck creatorTokens + cached reports (2+ rugs in last 10 = kill, no history = half size). Smart-wallet factor is GMGN-only; without a key it is dropped and its 20-point weight is redistributed over the other five Analyst factors. Pump.fun's frontend API is often Cloudflare-blocked from this host; that is treated as unavailable, not a fail-closed kill.
